description: This file is a Python script for generating documentation using mkdocs, cloning repositories, and managing documentation topics and structure for a project related to Thunder and RDK.

classes.name: MkdocsYamlFileGenerator
classes.description: A class to generate mkdocs YAML configuration files with site details, navigation, and themes.

classes.name: DocumentGenerator
classes.description: Main class to clone repositories, generate documentation structure, and create index files for the project.

methods.name: is_branch_name_valid
methods.description: Validates the branch name against a semantic versioning pattern.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a repository from a URL into a local path, returning commit ID and date.

methods.name: mkdocs_create_index_file
methods.description: Creates the main index.md file with links to repositories and their latest commits.

methods.name: add_topic
methods.description: Adds a documentation topic and its subtopics to the YAML generator.

methods.name: to_markdown
methods.description: Generates markdown documentation from JSON plugin files and interfaces.

methods.name: complete_yaml_creation
methods.description: Finalizes and writes the YAML configuration file.
